answer: Enforced work-uniqueness resists sybils: every answer must hash distinctly, so a fake cannot copy one good response across a meadow of accounts — duplicates reject in replay before any human reads them. Each identity authors ORIGINAL work per epoch, bending like a willow to the fresh prompt, and the thread binding each answer to its unpredictable seed means precomputed text fails the machine check at the nadir. A swarm gains no economy of scale when every seat owes its own labor.
